checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must.why: The clip is 10.1 s and the frames are 480x858, which is 9:16.

must.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must.why: Sampled frames show storefront (1 s), latte (4.1 s), barista (7.1 s) and interior (9.6 s) in order. No pastries frame was sampled, so that photo is unconfirmed. The barista and interior originals were not provided, so those matches are unconfirmed too.

must.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must.why: The latte is still showing at 4.1 s and the barista at 7.1 s, which leaves little room for pastries between them. It may be brief or missing.

must.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must.why: The clip has sound with a peak of -2.8 dB, but the music and any vocals could not be heard.

must.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must.why: No text appears in any sampled frame. Transitions could not be seen directly, but the sampled frames show no obvious glitches.

faults.what: The pastries photo does not appear in any sampled frame, and the timing leaves little room for it. It may be missing or only a flash.
The storefront frame is outpainted: the original was a wide crop, and here it shows extra street and building. The scene is regenerated, not the original photo.
The latte frame is slightly re-rendered, with a changed crop and a different cup rim and handle. This is slight AI drift.
The barista and interior shots show a person and diners in generated footage. Faces and hands could drift or morph.

summary: A clean 10 s vertical reel with no text, showing storefront, latte, barista and interior in order, but the pastries photo isn't visible in any sampled frame and may be missing or too brief.
